notice.aiSummary: Firms must notify the Financial Data Protection Office within 72 hours of discovering a personal data breach and must promptly notify affected customers when the breach poses high risk to them. These requirements take effect on January 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: This notice applies to any firm that holds personal data about retail customers, and Brivanta Bank holds personal data for its consumer and small business customers across all its deposit, lending, and payment products.

text:
FINANCIAL DATA PROTECTION OFFICE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Personal data breach notification
Notice number: RCN-2026-008
Issued by: Financial Data Protection Office
Published: 2026-09-29
Effective date: 2027-01-01
1. Who this applies to
Any firm that holds personal data about retail customers.
2. Background
Prompt notification lets the Office and customers limit the harm from a data breach.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must notify the Financial Data Protection Office of a personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it.
3.2 A firm must notify affected customers without undue delay when a breach is likely to put them at high risk.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-01-01.
Synthetic document written for a Snowflake example. The regulator, rule and numbers are fictional.

obligations.text: A firm must notify the Financial Data Protection Office of a personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it.
obligations.controlDesc: Breach log review confirms supervisor notification within 72 hours for each reportable breach
obligations.reason: Policy POL-PRV-02 states "The Privacy Office notifies the Financial Data Protection Office within 72 hours of the bank becoming aware of a breach," matching the obligation's 72-hour deadline exactly, and Control CTL-132 confirms "supervisor notification within 72 hours for each reportable breach."

obligations.text: A firm must notify affected customers without undue delay when a breach is likely to put them at high risk.
obligations.controlDesc: Monthly report of high-risk business customers whose beneficial ownership refresh is overdue
obligations.reason: Policy POL-PRV-02 states "notifies affected customers without undue delay when the risk to them is high," which matches the obligation's requirement exactly.
